ce_bugs.text: Stored XSS: content imported with cook_method raw_html bypasses sanitization and is rendered raw in embed view and topic pages, allowing script execution from malicious feed content (nothing strips <script>, event handlers, or javascript: URLs; CGI.unescapeHTML even decodes entity-encoded markup)

Attribute injection: url in the 'imported from' footer in topic_embed.rb is not HTML-escaped, so a URL containing a single quote can break out of the href attribute and inject arbitrary attributes/elements

topic_embeds rows are never cleaned up when their topic/post is deleted, causing EmbedController#best to raise on stale topic_id (permanent 500 with no recovery path) and TopicEmbed.import update path to call PostRevisor.new(nil)

Remote fetches in import_remote (topic_embed.rb) and PollFeed use open-uri with no open_timeout/read_timeout and no response size limit, allowing slow or malicious hosts to hang Sidekiq workers and huge responses to exhaust memory

Every uncached embed/best hit enqueues a RetrieveTopic job with no throttle at enqueue time, and each job synchronously runs a full feed poll (Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute) over the network before falling back to the single-page fetch, enabling an unauthenticated attacker to flood the Sidekiq queue and multiply resource usage

The embed loading page (loading.html.erb) reloads every 30 seconds while the response is only cached for 1 minute, so every viewer of a pending embed keeps re-hitting the endpoint and re-enqueuing RetrieveTopic jobs, multiplying load by viewer count

Stored XSS via raw_html cook method: post.rb returns raw unsanitized HTML when cook_method is :raw_html, and embed/best.html.erb renders it with raw post.cooked, allowing script injection from third-party RSS feed content (which is only CGI.unescapeHTML'd, not sanitized) into the Discourse origin

RSS feed path (Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed -> TopicEmbed.import) passes raw feed content into raw_html cook path with no filtering, allowing script/iframe/onerror attributes in stored cooked content (stored XSS)
Even in the whitelisted path, the readability tag whitelist allows javascript: hrefs since attributes %w[href src] are permitted without scheme validation
topic_embed.rb:14 interpolates feed-controlled url directly into unescaped href='#{url}', allowing single-quote breakout into arbitrary HTML
force: true added to already-shipped migration 20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb, causing silent drop of the top_topics table and its data on any re-run
Disqus import CLI drops the --category method_option with no replacement, breaking existing callers passing -c
Rewriting Disqus import from PostCreator to TopicEmbed.import_remote silently discards created_at, so imported posts get import-time timestamps with no way to preserve the original
SimpleRSS.parse open(...) can raise on network/parse errors with no error handling in the poll feed job
Non-atomic setnx/expire throttle in TopicRetriever can leave a Redis key with no TTL if the process dies between calls, permanently blocking the embed URL for non-staff users
Anonymous /embed/best enqueues a RetrieveTopic Sidekiq job on every cache-miss for an unknown embed_url (user_id: nil), creating an unauthenticated job-enqueue/DoS vector

Stored XSS: remote HTML scraped via TopicEmbed.import_remote (Readability tag whitelist doesn't sanitize attribute payloads like javascript: hrefs) is persisted and rendered raw with no sanitization on write or render path (Post#cook raw_html + embed view raw post.cooked)

HTML injection via embed_url in the 'imported from' footer in TopicEmbed.rb — url is interpolated directly into a single-quoted href with no escaping, allowing attribute breakout and stored XSS reachable from public /embed/best endpoint

No error handling or timeouts on any network fetch (PollFeed, import_remote open(url).read, TopicRetriever fetch_http) — network errors crash the poll with no log-and-continue, and the 60-second Redis throttle key is set before the fetch so transient failures with retry: false never actually retry

Infinite reload/retry loop with no terminal failure state — if retrieval permanently fails the loading page reloads every 30 seconds indefinitely, each reload enqueues another RetrieveTopic job, and the throttle is bypassed entirely for staff (no_throttle: user.staff?) causing unbounded remote fetches

Referer-only guard with no rate limiting on the /embed/best enqueuing endpoint — forged Referer plus arbitrary embed_url enables request amplification against the job queue and embedded host; throttle is per-URL so varying the path bypasses it
Origin check in embed.js uses substring matching (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)) instead of exact origin parsing/comparison, breaking resize on scheme/port mismatches and misconfigured discourseUrl

Test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:44-48 asserts TopicRetriever is instantiated and retrieve is called, but EmbedController#best enqueues a background job and never instantiates TopicRetriever directly, so the expectation cannot be satisfied by the real code (test verifies mocks, not the job enqueue/argument passing/fallback render behavior)

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:2 has a copy-paste error: require_dependency 'jobs/regular/process_post' instead of the poll feed job, documenting the wrong dependency; similarly topic_retriever_spec.rb requires 'topic_retriever' as a dependency while retrieve_topic.rb relies on auto-requiring it
Raw-HTML cook path returns unsanitized external content as cooked HTML, which embed/best.html.erb renders with raw post.cooked, enabling XSS from the embedded host's content
TopicRetriever#fetch_http crashes with NoMethodError on nil when SiteSetting.embed_by_username is blank but embeddable_host is set (lib/topic_retriever.rb:47)

PollFeed and the retriever re-evaluate guard conditions inconsistently (PollFeed checks feed_polling_url/embed_by_username, the retriever doesn't), and the two entry points can race on TopicEmbed.import
Unescaped URL interpolated into single-quoted HTML attribute in the imported-from footer (app/models/topic_embed.rb:14), allowing attribute breakout since URL is only validated by /^https?::////

Check-then-create race on topic_embeds.embed_url unique index in TopicEmbed.import (topic_embed.rb:19-31): concurrent workers race and the loser raises on the unique index with no rescue, and PollFeed sets retry: false so the failure is silent

Modified already-shipped migration 20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb adds force: true, which drops and recreates the top_topics table in environments where the migration hasn't run, silently discarding data
String#scrub in poll_feed.rb:38 requires Ruby 2.1+, an implicit runtime constraint not declared anywhere
Duplicated embed-user lookup (User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first) in poll_feed.rb:27 and topic_retriever.rb:47 with divergent nil-guarding

`force: true` on `create_table :topic_embeds` will silently drop an existing topic_embeds table before recreating it, destroying embed→topic mappings and content_sha1 bookkeeping with no rollback or warning

`force: true` added to already-committed migration CreateTopTopics is destructive DDL that drops the top_topics table and all its aggregated ranking data if the migration re-runs while the table exists

Raw HTML import path (Post.rb cook_method raw_html combined with embed/best.html.erb rendering raw post.cooked) bypasses the sanitizer and after_post_cook filters, resulting in stored XSS on the Discourse origin for embed visitors
topic_embeds lacks index/FK on topic_id and post_id, so deleted topics leave orphaned embed rows that cause EmbedController#best to raise on a missing topic instead of gracefully falling back

embed_url is stored and compared without normalization, so scheme/trailing-slash variants create duplicate topics for the same article and cause lookups to miss existing embeds and re-enqueue retrieval forever
The raw_html cook method in post.rb:131 bypasses the entire cooking/sanitization pipeline with no downstream sanitization

PollFeed passes unescaped feed content (i.content) straight to TopicEmbed.import with no tag/attribute whitelist, allowing script, iframe, onerror handlers, or javascript: hrefs to be stored and rendered verbatim
embed/best.html.erb renders post.cooked with raw output, so stored malicious HTML from feeds is rendered unsanitized

The readability path (import_remote) whitelists a[href] but does not sanitize URL schemes, so javascript: hrefs survive; absolutize_urls only rewrites hrefs starting with / and does not sanitize schemes
/embed/best is served from the forum's own origin with X-Frame-Options set to ALLOWALL, so injected scripts execute with full access on the forum origin

mrv_findings.text: poll_feed.rb: CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError when i.content is nil (RSS 2.0 description-only or Atom summary feeds), and with retry: false the scheduled job dies permanently and silently with no alert or logging
poll_feed.rb: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) has no error handling, so one network failure or 500 response on the feed URL permanently kills the feed polling job
spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only verifies poll_feed is called, never that it survives a bad feed — the job's failure surface is unverified
topic_retriever.rb:50: fetch_http calls SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase without a presence check, crashing with NoMethodError on nil when embed_by_username is blank but embeddable_host is set

topic_embed.rb:24-31: TopicEmbed is not destroyed when its topic or post is deleted (no dependent: :destroy), causing EmbedController#best to raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound and return a permanent 500 for that embed URL
topic_embed.rb: update path does PostRevisor.new(embed.post) with a nil post after post deletion, causing NoMethodError inside the hourly PollFeed job
poll_feed.rb:18-19: feed_key is defined but never used — the Last-Modified feed-deduplication logic was never implemented, so every run re-downloads and re-processes every feed item
topic_retriever.rb:41-44: perform_retrieve invokes the full PollFeed inline on every embed request of an unknown URL, so N unknown embed URLs trigger N full feed re-fetches within the throttle window

create_top_topics.rb migration: changing an already-committed migration to use force: true silently drops the existing top_topics table in environments where the table exists but the migration hasn't run, causing data loss
create_topic_embeds migration also uses force: true, which can silently drop the table

topic_embed.rb:60-77: absolutize_urls only handles leading-slash URLs, so protocol-relative (//cdn.example.com/...) and bare-relative (images/foo.jpg) URLs pass through unchanged and render broken inside the embedded topic
topic_embed.rb:23-29: when content_sha1 changes, only the post body is revised — the topic title is never updated, leaving stale titles on edited articles

embed/loading.html.erb: no terminal failure state — if retrieval permanently fails, the page reloads every 30 seconds indefinitely with an infinite 'Loading Discussion...' spinner and no error surfaced to the embedding site

topic_embed.rb:15-21: unique index race on TopicEmbed.create! — concurrent imports of the same URL (controller path vs PollFeed) raise unrescued ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique, crashing the job and rolling back the topic
embed_controller_spec.rb:48-53: the success rendering path mocks TopicView, so best.html.erb (including nil user and blank posts branches) has never been executed by any test
No spec covers the 'retrieval fails' flow for the embed loading view

Unrelated rewrite of the Disqus import task in lib/tasks/disqus.thor:114-141 removes the --category CLI option and drops created_at, causing imported Disqus topics to lose category targeting and be stamped with import time instead of the original thread date

Modification of existing applied migration db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb adds force: true, which drops the existing top_topics table and destroys all its rows if the migration is ever re-run
embed.js in app/assets/javascripts/ is never servable or distributed: the diff contains no route, precompile-list addition, or documented include path, making the embed feature unusable as shipped
Dead code in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:20-22: feed_key is defined but never referenced, pointing maintainers at a caching invariant that does not exist

Dead client locale entry in config/locales/client.en.yml:1477 adds 'embedding' to the client-side admin settings category list but no corresponding site settings have client: true, leaving an unrenderable UI string
Unrelated whitespace churn in db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb (trailing-whitespace fixup and removal of trailing newline) pollutes the history of an unrelated pre-existing migration
External untrusted HTML from feed content is stored and rendered as raw cooked content with no sanitization, enabling arbitrary script execution from a compromised feed (XSS)
Even the readability path whitelists tags but keeps href/src attributes verbatim, so javascript: URLs in links survive sanitization

feed_key is computed in PollFeed but never used; the feed-modified check to skip re-parsing unchanged feeds is unimplemented dead code, causing unbounded re-fetching and re-parsing proportional to feed size on a hot path

i.content.scrub in PollFeed crashes with NoMethodError on standard RSS 2.0 feeds because SimpleRSS leaves content nil for description-based items, and with retry: false the polling job dies silently so no topics are ever imported via polling

TopicRetriever synchronously re-runs the entire feed poll (Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})) inline to service a single URL retrieval, doing O(whole feed) work per request with the throttle bypassed for staff users

Every render of loading.html.erb by anonymous visitors enqueues a retrieve_topic job before any throttle check, flooding the Sidekiq queue since the redis throttle only dedups execution, not enqueuing
The 30-second reload loop in loading.html.erb has no terminal state, backoff, or client-side stop condition, so a URL that can never be imported reloads and re-enqueues forever

No URL normalization on the embed_url join key between the two ingestion paths (feed link vs discourseEmbedUrl), so discrepancies like trailing slashes, http vs https, or query strings cause permanent lookup misses and duplicate topic imports

No dependent: :destroy, FK, or destroy hook for TopicEmbed rows, so deleting the imported post or topic leaves a dangling TopicEmbed; the next feed poll then crashes on PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! with NoMethodError
If the topic is deleted, topic_id_for_embed returns a stale id and TopicView.new raises RecordNotFound, causing a permanent 500 on embed/best for that URL
Origin check in embed.js uses a substring test (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)) instead of an origin comparison, so any origin that is a substring of the forum URL passes the check
layouts/embed.html.erb injects request.referer unescaped into a JS string literal as the postMessage targetOrigin
The raw_html cook path returns before Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...), silently bypassing the documented plugin extension point for imported posts
The change to PostRevisor at line 85 makes skip_validations bypass all model validations for any caller of the revisor, a global behavioral change to a shared library beyond just the embed path
Disqus import via TopicEmbed.import_remote silently loses created_at, giving every imported thread the current timestamp and destroying chronological ordering of the archive
The -c/--category CLI option was removed from the Disqus import task with no replacement, breaking existing scripts that pass it

Outbound fetches in TopicRetriever and TopicEmbed use bare open-uri with no explicit timeout, so a slow remote site stalls the RetrieveTopic worker indefinitely and locks out retries for that URL for 60s

Unsanitized URL interpolated into raw HTML footer in app/models/topic_embed.rb:11 allows stored XSS; the ^https?:// regex validation passes malicious URLs like http://x.com/"><script>alert(1)</script>, which are rendered raw via cook_method: raw_html
The sanitization intent of import_remote (readability tag whitelist) is silently undone by the import method appending the unescaped URL fragment in the same code path

RSS content path in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:33 has no sanitization at all; PollFeed calls TopicEmbed.import directly bypassing the readability whitelist, so arbitrary HTML including <script> and <iframe> is stored verbatim as cooked and rendered raw, enabling stored XSS from a malicious feed
A single malformed feed item permanently blocks the entire feed import: i.content is nil on RSS 2.0 feeds that only provide description, causing NoMethodError on nil.scrub that aborts the loop

No per-item rescue in PollFeed combined with sidekiq_options retry: false means one bad item or open() failure prevents all subsequent items from being imported and the job fails silently with no retry every hour forever

raw_html cook method in app/models/post.rb:132 bypasses the after_post_cook plugin filter contract, silently skipping all plugins hooking that filter while posts still appear as normal topics in the main forum

Disqus import in lib/tasks/disqus.thor silently changed behavior: --category option and original timestamps dropped; new behavior scrapes remote article body, uses current timestamps, and cannot target a category

No failure path in app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:13 with loading view; if retrieval fails no TopicEmbed row is created, so every subsequent request re-enqueues and re-renders 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely
Loading view's 30-second setTimeout reload combined with 1-minute response caching means even on success visitors can stare at a reloading 'Loading' screen for up to a minute

Update path in app/models/topic_embed.rb:31 crashes on orphaned embeds; posts can be deleted by moderators while topic_embeds row remains, so embed.post is nil and PostRevisor.new(nil) raises, killing the whole scheduled poll

feed_key method in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:19-21 is dead code; the conditional-fetch/Last-Modified caching intent was silently dropped, so the full feed is re-fetched and every item re-processed every hour

Unrelated modification of already-shipped migration db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb: force: true will silently DROP TABLE any existing top_topics data if run against a database where the table exists outside schema-migrations; appears to be a local-dev hack
Whitespace-only edits to unrelated shipped migration 20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb included as churn in the diff

The PR folds in three unacknowledged objective changes (raw_html trust model, Disqus tool rewrite, unrelated migration modifications) beyond its stated 'embed URL handling and validation' objective; items #1, #2, #4 combined constitute a security regression that should block merge until the footer is escaped and both import paths run through a common sanitizer

Stored XSS: Post#cook returns raw content when cook_method is raw_html, bypassing the sanitization pipeline; TopicEmbed.import stores un-sanitized external HTML as post.cooked which is rendered with raw post.cooked in the embed view (app/models/post.rb:131, app/views/embed/best.html.erb:21)

PollFeed imports feed content with zero HTML filtering: raw RSS content is passed directly to TopicEmbed.import which stores it as raw_html; CGI.unescapeHTML actively decodes entities, re-materializing encoded script tags as live markup (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29-33)

Unescaped URL interpolated into a single-quoted href attribute in the imported_from footer with no escaping; the upstream validation regex permits quotes and spaces, enabling attribute-injection stored XSS from feed item links (app/models/topic_embed.rb:8)

SSRF via redirect-following defeats the host check: open-uri transparently follows HTTP redirects so an open redirect on the embeddable host lets the server-side fetch pivot to internal services like cloud metadata endpoints; the invalid_host? check never re-runs on redirects (app/models/topic_embed.rb:41-42, lib/topic_retriever.rb:15-17)

Referer header used as an authorization gate: Referer is fully client-controlled so any non-browser client can forge it to bypass the embeddable_host check, while also denying legitimate users whose privacy extensions strip Referer (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:26-28)

postMessage origin check uses substring matching (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) instead of strict origin equality, allowing origins that are substrings of the configured URL to pass the check (app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:15)
Migrations use force: true in create_table, which drops pre-existing tables and risks data loss (db/migrate/20131217233733_create_topic_embeds.rb, 20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb)
Readability tag/attribute whitelist does not filter URL schemes, so href="javascript:..." attributes survive sanitization

The 'is 404 without an embed_url' test in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:7 verifies nothing — the request fails because ensure_embeddable raises Discourse::InvalidAccess (embeddable_host defaults to '') before params.require(:embed_url) is reached, and Rails returns 400 (ParameterMissing) rather than 404, so the test would pass even if the params.require line were deleted

The 'creates a topic view when a topic_id is found' test (spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40-44) only asserts that a mock was constructed; render_views is not declared so best.html.erb is never rendered and the endpoint's actual output (best-of-5 post selection, fallback rendering, header/footer output) is never checked

The 'requires feed_polling_url' and 'requires embed_by_username' tests (spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:17-27) don't isolate their conditions — neither stubs feed_polling_enabled?, which defaults to false, so poll_feed is never called and both tests would pass even if the .present? checks were deleted

The entire poll_feed body (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:22-35) is untested — the url fallback to i.id when blank or non-http, CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub), the user.blank? early return, and delegation to TopicEmbed.import are never executed because the delegation test stubs poll_feed itself

The valid-host tests in spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:32-43 stub all real logic and verify only mock orchestration — the 60-second Redis throttle, no_throttle staff bypass, existing-embed bail-out, PollFeed-first path, and fetch_http's user lookup are never exercised

The change-detection branch in spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:41-44 is only tested on its true side — no test imports identical content a second time, so the sha1 comparison's no-op path (preventing redundant revisions) is unverified and deleting the condition would not fail any test
import_remote's Readability path (topic_embed.rb:38-47) is untested by any test in the diff
The non-80/443 port-prefix branch of absolutize_urls (topic_embed.rb:61) is untested by any test in the diff

Destructive edit to already-shipped migration: `force: true` added to create_top_topics.rb will drop the existing top_topics table without backup when re-run (db:reset, restore-then-migrate, partially-failed db:migrate:reset), silently destroying all top-topic data

`force: true` on new production table topic_embeds in create_topic_embeds.rb: if topic_embeds exists with rows from a partial application or halfway deploy, the migration silently DROPs it, irrecoverably losing the embed_url-to-topic mapping, content_sha1 change-tracking state, and requiring re-crawling to regenerate

topic_embeds table references topics.id and posts.id with plain integer columns (no foreign key, no ON DELETE) and no destroy hook on the topic side, so topic/post deletion permanently orphans topic_embeds rows
Orphaned topic_embeds rows cause EmbedController#best to 500 on the publisher's page by calling TopicView.new on a dead topic_id

Orphaned topic_embeds rows permanently poison the embed URL: TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve bails on TopicEmbed.where(embed_url:).exists?, the unique index blocks re-import, and TopicEmbed.import takes the update branch and crashes on PostRevisor.new(nil) since embed.post is nil

topic_embed.rb:29 unconditionally persists the new content_sha1 via update_column even when the PostRevisor revise! failed or returned false, so future polls skip the revision and source article changes are never synced to the post with no error surfaced

Post#cook reads the new cook_method column in the same release that adds it via add_cook_method_to_posts migration, with no expand phase: during a rolling deploy where a process runs new code against an unmigrated schema, every post creation raises ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid/MissingAttributeError, breaking the whole forum
